stories.title: Scientists are building a microscope powered by a quantum computer
stories.desc: Scientists are combining an electron microscope with a quantum computer to squeeze far more information from each electron. The approach could reveal faint details with fewer electrons, helping protect fragile samples that conventional microscopy can damage.

stories.title: An Early Look at Fall Color in Canada
stories.desc: Reds, yellows, and oranges are already sweeping across tundra landscapes in Nunavut. The post An Early Look at Fall Color in Canada appeared first on NASA Science .
